ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (dark) surface with a high dominance of black pixels; high-intensity (white) pixels are confined to sparse focal points, resulting in a low macro-level contrast ratio.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Continuous solid dark-intensity pigmentation across the entire visible ventral surface, punctuated by discrete, high-contrast circular geometric blobs (approx. 5-10 pixels in diameter) distributed across the mid-lateral zones of both lobes.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped central depression with an acute interior angle estimated at 45 degrees and a vertical depth comprising approximately 15% of the visible lobe height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular saw-tooth pattern along the continuous trailing boundary; pixel amplitude of peaks is variable, with approximately 16-20 distinct serration points per lobe lobe.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Overall convex mathematical curve extending from the median notch to the distal tips, interrupted by local high-frequency serrations.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Spatially distinct clusters of roughly circular high-contrast pixel points; approximately 8 clusters on the left lobe and 5-6 on the right lobe, consistent with rosette-style scarring.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A prominent, non-uniform indentation on the medial portion of the right lobe trailing edge, exceeding the amplitude of surrounding serrations.
other_distinctive_markers: Vertical high-intensity linear reflection or artifact extending from the water boundary directly to the vertex of the median notch.
